not_run.campaign-regtest-replay: Needs the regtest node of scripts/build_core_node.sh in build/core-node, which the workflow does not build.
not_run.subsidy-seeds: Takes about 85 minutes on a GitHub runner, and the workflow has 300 minutes for all gates. Run it on a contributor's machine.
not_run.version-bits-walk: Fetches the mainnet headers from the maintainer's node.
not_run.impact-runs-on-the-ranges: Needs the range fixtures from the maintainer's node and the snapshots of the Core pass. Each run takes hours on one core.
not_run.impact-run-to-145-000: Needs the fixtures of the replay to 145,000 from the maintainer's node, and takes more than a day.
not_run.mainnet-replay-to-145-000: Needs the blocks to height 145,000 from the maintainer's node, and the oracle takes about 17 hours.
not_run.snapshot-range-s: Needs the blocks to height 145,000 from the maintainer's node.
not_run.core-pass: Reads about 180 GB of blocks from the maintainer's node.
not_run.mainnet-range: Needs the Core pass and the range fixtures from the maintainer's node.
